DESCRIPTION:
Handles Authentication

USAGE:
    dgtp profile [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    dgtp profile create <Name> <Url> --msal

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help               Prints help information                            
        --no-telemetry       Disable telemetry for this invocation              
        --non-interactive    Disable interactive prompts (e.g. MSAL browser     
                             login). When set, commands that require interactive
                             authentication will exit with code 2 (AuthRequired)
                             instead of opening a browser. Alternatively set the
                             environment variable DGTP_NON_INTERACTIVE=true.    
                             Recommended for coding agents and CI pipelines     

COMMANDS:
    list                                List profiles                           
    create <Name> <ConnectionString>    Create a new profile                    
    delete <Name>                       Delete a profile                        
    select <Name>                       Select a profile                        
    purge                               Purge all profiles                      
    auth-check                          Checks whether the current MSAL token is
                                        still valid without opening a browser.  
                                        Exit code 0 = token valid, 2 =          
                                        interactive login required. Intended as 
                                        a pre-flight check for coding agents

USAGE:
    dgtp push <FileOrFolder> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    dgtp push c:/TargetDir/plugin.dll --solution samplesolution

ARGUMENTS:
    <FileOrFolder>    Full path to the dll file, e.g. C:\temp\plugin.dll or to  
                      folder for webressources                                  

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                      Prints help information                     
        --no-telemetry              Disable telemetry for this invocation       
        --non-interactive           Disable interactive prompts (e.g. MSAL      
                                    browser login). When set, commands that     
                                    require interactive authentication will exit
                                    with code 2 (AuthRequired) instead of       
                                    opening a browser. Alternatively set the    
                                    environment variable                        
                                    DGTP_NON_INTERACTIVE=true. Recommended for  
                                    coding agents and CI pipelines              
        --solution                  Add Objects to Solution; default: none;     
                                    mandatory for webressources                 
        --delete-obsolete           Delete obsolete unmanaged webressources in  
                                    solution; dangerous!                        
        --publish                   Publish changed objects                     
        --delete-on-upgrade         Delete old assembly on Upgrade; migrates    
                                    plugin steps and Custom API references to   
                                    new assembly before deletion                
        --no-migrate-custom-apis    Do not migrate Custom API references to new 
                                    assembly on Upgrade (ignored when           
                                    --delete-on-upgrade is set)
